name: artifact

file_path.description: Path to the HTML (.html/.htm) or Markdown (.md) file to upload (relative or absolute)

ttl.description: Time-to-live. Use '7d' for 7-day expiry (default), '30d' for 30-day expiry.

description: [MCP:artifact] Upload an HTML or Markdown file to a public URL with automatic expiry. Markdown files (.md) are automatically converted to a styled HTML page (GFM tables, fenced code blocks, blockquotes, headings). HTML files are served verbatim. The file will be accessible via a shareable link for 7 days (default) or 30 days. Use this after generating content (dashboards, reports, prototypes) that you want to share.
